name: parity-basic
description: Baseline Jinja-subset grammar. This is the acceptance target for cococo-ui's Jinja expansion (its engine today does `$.` paths + simple `{{ $.x }}` substitution only — no filters/operators/ternary). Every runtime (SurfaceKit-Swift, @cococo/surfaces-TS) must reproduce these.
status: SEED — verify expected values against the SurfaceKit (WorkflowKit-derived) evaluator when the engine is ported; grammar per docs/surfaces + cococo-app Gateway/Workspaces/Expression.
rules: A standalone `{{ expr }}` (only whitespace around it) resolves to a TYPED value.
`{{ }}` mixed with surrounding text resolves to a STRING.
A whole string beginning `$.` (no braces) is a typed path reference; missing -> null.
A string with neither is a literal.
Missing member reference inside `{{ }}` is null (standalone) or empty (in text); never throws.
